title: Screen Readers in Practice
description: Real NVDA and VoiceOver behaviour on Havenmark's product listing, filters, and cart — browse vs. focus mode, the rotor, and how headings, landmarks, tables, and forms actually get announced.

title: Navigating Without a Mouse or Full Vision
description: Keyboard-only operation of Havenmark's checkout, and what the checkout looks and behaves like at 200-400% zoom under reflow, reduced motion, and forced-colors mode.

title: Alternative Input and the Test Matrix
description: Operating Havenmark's account pages by voice and by switch, then converting everything this domain covered into the artefact a QA engagement actually ships: an AT test matrix with a defensible reason for every row.
